paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the harmful refusal ratio across a range of input token lengths for several language models. The x-axis, labeled “Input Token Length,” is a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 128. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful Refusal Ratio,” extends from 0 to 0.5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The blue line, representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, begins at a ratio of approximately 0.22 at 128 tokens, increasing to a ratio of approximately 0.42 at 1024 tokens. The orange line, depicting Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, starts at a ratio of approximately 0.18 at 128 tokens and rises to a ratio of approximately 0.39 at 1024 tokens. The green line, showing LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, begins at a ratio of approximately 0.20 at 128 tokens and reaches a ratio of approximately 0.33 at 1024 tokens. Finally, the red line, representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, starts at a ratio of approximately 0.14 at 128 tokens and increases to a ratio of approximately 0.28 at 1024 tokens.
